channel.title: FPL Weekly
channel.description: Weekly briefing on digitalization, AI, automation and circular construction from the Future Planning Lab.

item.title: FPL Weekly #1: Robots get funded, geotech meets live data, concrete goes round
item.description: Construction robotics drew big money this week: ICON's multi-storey 3D printer, Origin's wall-finishing robot and All3's legged site robots. Hexagon is buying the geotechnical software maker Rocscience to feed live sensor data into engineering models, a Dutch start-up got €100M to recycle demolition concrete into new concrete, and a new EU project wants reclaimed building parts to get a 'beautiful' second life. Our focus: what BIM really is, and why it is not yet a digital twin.
